facts: Elizabeth Holmes spoke at The Journal's WSJDLive event on Wednesday, October 22, 2015.
Holmes stated that Theranos has not used the technology referred to as Edison for a few years.
Theranos received FDA approval for its herpes test (HSV) in July.
Theranos operates in California, Pennsylvania, and Arizona.
Holmes claimed that Google Ventures reached out to Theranos and Theranos declined to meet with them.
Holmes responded to criticisms regarding blood sample dilution during the interview.
